newsitem.title: UK: IPE prompt natgas eases, next summer firms.
newsitem.headline: IPE prompt natgas eases, next summer firms.

text.p: Busy trade failed to lead the IPE natural gas futures contract in any particular direction on Monday, with the remaining months of this year talked weaker but firmer prices next summer.
A total of 455 lots were traded over the two sessions, with open interest at 4615 lots at the close of trade.
Trade was most active in the first quarter of 1998, particularly in March where 160 lots changed hands.
The biggest swing in price was in June 1998, which last traded 0.220 p/th higher at 10.750 p/th. Prompt months were all talked weaker but were untraded.
